title: Dubosc en plein doute  (Dubosc in Doubt)

segments.t: With ASK struggling to hold onto its roster of stars, Andrea Martel orders Gabriel to check on popular actor Franck Dubosc. Arriving on the set of an avant-garde arthouse movie, Gabriel finds the famous comedian thoroughly demoralized by an eccentric director and an arrogant young co-star. Ready to abandon both the film and his agents, Dubosc pours out his grievances. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Gabriel, nous devons garder Franck chez nous.
Il tourne un beau film d'auteur.
Bonjour Franck, je viens parler de ton avenir.
C'est le pire tournage de ma vie!
La réalisatrice réécrit constamment toutes les scènes.
Elle me demande toujours de jouer moins.
Elle cherche simplement une émotion très pure.
Mon jeune partenaire se moque de moi.
Ce film est ton grand tournant dramatique.
Ce rôle sera ton Tchao Pantin.
Je ne conviens pas à ce cinéma.
Je veux quitter ce tournage sans attendre.
Et je vais aussi quitter votre agence.
Attends, parlons calmement de tout cela.
Let's observe as Gabriel tries to comfort a demoralized Franck Dubosc on set.
Gabriel, nous devons garder Franck chez nous.
'Gabriel, we must keep Franck with us.' An urgent executive order emphasizing the vital need to retain bankable talent.
Il tourne un beau film d'auteur.
'He is shooting a fine arthouse film.' An optimistic assumption about the prestigious creative project.
Bonjour Franck, je viens parler de ton avenir.
'Hello Franck, I come to talk about your future.' A diplomatic opening broaching representation and agency loyalty.
C'est le pire tournage de ma vie!
'It is the worst shoot of my life!' An explosive grievance revealing acute misery on the production.
La réalisatrice réécrit constamment toutes les scènes.
'The director constantly rewrites all the scenes.' An exasperated complaint criticizing unpredictable artistic methods.
Elle me demande toujours de jouer moins.
'She always asks me to act less.' A baffled protest against confusing minimalist acting directions.
Elle cherche simplement une émotion très pure.
'She is simply seeking a very pure emotion.' A tactful defense translating avant-garde intentions into positive craft goals.
Mon jeune partenaire se moque de moi.
'My young co-star makes fun of me.' A painful confession detailing disrespect from an arrogant newcomer.
Ce film est ton grand tournant dramatique.
'This movie is your big dramatic turning point.' An encouraging perspective framing the struggle as a career breakthrough.
Ce rôle sera ton Tchao Pantin.
'This role will be your Tchao Pantin.' A flattering historical analogy recalling Coluche's legendary dramatic transition.
Je ne conviens pas à ce cinéma.
'I am not suited to this cinema.' A frank admission recognizing an uncomfortable cultural misfit.
Je veux quitter ce tournage sans attendre.
'I want to leave this shoot without waiting.' A reckless threat announcing an immediate walkout from the film.
Et je vais aussi quitter votre agence.
'And I am also going to leave your agency.' A devastating escalation threatening to sever ties with ASK completely.
Attends, parlons calmement de tout cela.
'Wait, let's talk calmly about all this.' A soothing intervention attempting to prevent an irreversible rupture. Now let's listen to Andrea, Gabriel, and Franck talking again at full speed.

Confronted with Franck Dubosc's deep creative despair and threat to abandon ASK, Gabriel realizes he faces a major crisis. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'must' and 'look after'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
À demain!
